title: Feng Shui Master
description: A fully AI-generated Chinese supernatural microdrama (风水天师) following a feng shui master who takes on evil spirits and curses — one of the biggest breakout hits of China's AI short-drama wave.
descriptionMore: Produced entirely with AI generation and no live shoot, the series' first season reportedly hit 100 million views within 12 hours of release and 300 million within 48 — a launch widely cited as a turning point for AI-made microdramas in China. It has since run to multiple seasons (up to Season 5 / 82 episodes), with cumulative views reported above 1.3 billion.
